title: Where will guests stay during the Mahotsav, and can we book accommodation outside Ashaeiynn?

segments.text: Staying at Ashaeiynn ​Primary Accommodation: Guests are highly encouraged to stay directly within the Ashaeiynn premises to fully immerse themselves in the spiritual atmosphere, daily activities, and community life of the Mahotsav. ​Independent Stay & Hotel Options ​Freedom to Choose: If you prefer your own personal space or separate arrangements, you are completely free to book accommodation outside the ashram. ​Nearby & City Hotels: ​Hotel Green Beach: Conveniently located within short walking distance from Ashaeiynn, making it an ideal choice for quick back-and-forth travel. However, room availability at Hotel Green Beach is quite low, so it is best to avoid relying on it and instead look for options directly in Hisar city or Azad Nagar. ​Other City Options: Hisar city offers plenty of reputable choices, such as Lemon Tree and many others. A quick search on Google will bring up a wide array of choices to suit your preferences. ​Recommended List: If you would like tailored suggestions, feel free to ask your mentor for a curated list of recommended hotel options nearby. ​Long-Term Rental Options ​Monthly House Rentals: For those planning an extended stay (such as a month or the entire duration of the Mahotsav), renting a house or apartment in Hisar city or Azad Nagar is a practical and convenient option. ​Commuting Note: Since the ashram is situated on the outskirts of the city, having your own vehicle or personal transportation is recommended if you choose to rent or stay further within the city proper.
